package.name: sdsm_trust_perception
package.description: Second-layer trust check on SDSM traffic: an independent per-node TrustEngine (reputation, kinematic-plausibility and size-agreement checks, corroboration, a deferred grace ledger) that judges what each simulated vehicle actually received, on top of the 802.11p channel model. Ported from CPX-Mono's ros2/src/global_trust_perception, ros2/src/global_trust_tracker, and ros2/src/local_trust_estimation's trust-calculation core — see that repo for the full design writeup. Adapted for CPX-SDSM's SensorDataSharingMessage wire format via pipeline/sdsm_codec.py (see its module docstring for what this sim's wire format can and cannot supply, notably: no per-object local certainty, so this port's judgment rests entirely on the second-layer checks rather than on a sender's own claimed confidence).
